label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: far-forward ZDC, hadronic section (SiPM-on-tile), as in the ePIC simulation geometry 26.11.0, status development

quantities.name: steel_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of the steel along the section's axis (64 absorber plates and the back plate)
quantities.derivation: 65 x 2 cm (eic:C11) x 7.85 g/cm3 (eic:C15) / 13.84 g/cm2 (PDG, iron)

sources.source: PDG Atomic and Nuclear Properties, iron (2025 web edition)
sources.value: radiation length 13.84 g/cm2 (1.757 cm at 7.874 g/cm3)

independence.result: independent of Geant4: the plate thickness and density are design values written as input to the ePIC simulation, not outputs of it, and the radiation length is PDG's tabulation for iron; Steel235's 0.2% carbon is neglected in the reference. The reference is not a Geant4 output. Geant4 computes radiation lengths with the same Tsai formula, so agreement validates the geometry and the material definition (composition and density), not Geant4's radiation-length physics.

quantities.name: cells
quantities.definition: readout cells of the scintillator layers in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: 12 x 11 cells in even layers and 11 x 11 in odd layers of 48.8 mm (eic:C13), 64 layers (eic:C11); the 2026 Preins talk states 8096 channels (tier 3)

independence.result: a design count, not a simulation output; the case is built from the same geometry release, so it checks how the segmentation is expressed, not physics

approximations: the staggered grid (CartesianGridXYStaggered) is expressed as even and odd layers of their own cell counts; the per-layer offsets of the cells are not modelled
the EM section is left out, its design not settled (eic:C14 and the maintainer's decision)
the section is at the origin along z: its placement 35.8 m from the IP on the -25 mrad axis (eic:C12) is recorded, not modelled
ESR foil as polystyrene and FR4 as silica at 1.86 g/cm3, as the release models them or close to it
status: validated-in-scope (comparison with cited values, not confirmation)
